availability.selectionPolicy: Latest snapshot with available_as_of and inserted_at <= frozen decision, exact event/teams/schedule match; one game is one observation.
availability.predictiveMetricsReason: ZERO_MATCHING_FINAL_OUTCOMES; no prospective manual model prediction exists in this contract.

certification.scope: Claims and internal consistency of persisted features; independent raw calendar and seed source receipts were not part of the export.

integrityChecks.scope: All 14 snapshots / 28 team instances; rounded-rate tolerance 1.1e-6.

validationGapProbes.method: Synthetic mutations of a deep clone of an actual row/export, in memory only; not persisted. These probes describe validator scope, not faults found in actual data.

limitations: PRESERVED_SEED with no standings capture time applies to every one of 14 snapshots, not only event 0378. Current-through date is a claim, not a fresh receipt.
The two source runs repeat identical team inputs for each of the seven games. Do not double denominators.
Only late V6 had the manual snapshots available as of its frozen decision. Original and early snapshots precede the manual input.
No matching final outcomes exist at export cutoff. Do not report accuracy, Brier, log-loss, EV or ROI as zero or as evidence.
All latest teams have one rest day and no back-to-back; this tranche cannot identify a rest effect.
L10 completeness and period coverage are internally consistent claims. The raw independent calendar is absent from this export.
Goalie reports retain distinct status and clocks. All reported player_id are absent; matching by normalized name and uncertain starters limit interpretation.
Full published dataset bytes are not part of the table exports; source_snapshot_sha256 is preserved but not independently recomputed against source dataset bytes.
H2H, injuries, market contracts, ranks and full team game history do not cross this contract.
The raw contract includes venue records and goalie recent statistics even though the current Pick panel projection omits them.
